description: Treatment (kb_dynamic_alpha) metrics on the same query set. Compare against before_report.json to measure lift. Harness ran 2026-05-03 with 266 proposals ingested into spike.db.
note: kb_dynamic_alpha mode calls `aimee kb search --fusion-mode dynamic_alpha`. Returned empty on 2026-05-03 because Qdrant was in D-state (memory pressure) and no `proposals` KB project exists yet. Closeout decision: benchmark gate not met; runtime remains opt-in and the default stays `rrf`. When a proposals project is indexed, rerun: python3 spikes/typed-extraction/eval.py --mode kb_dynamic_alpha --queries small
